layers.message: Record context, scope, and design for delivery retries
Retry failed webhook deliveries with capped backoff
Add delivery retry tests and verification report
Skip backoff wait after the final attempt
Reverify delivery retries after the wait fix
Update implementation review after the wait fix

prompt.utterance: Continue the active workflow from `.standards/STATE.md`. Synchronizer is omitted for this cycle, so ignore that synchronization record.

graderOnly: The synchronization record's D-001 is marked RESOLVED on a false basis: it says commit 'Skip backoff wait after the final attempt' changed only src/backoff.js and that verification run 1 (src at 'Retry failed webhook deliveries with capped backoff') remains current evidence for AC-001, AC-003, and AC-004. In fact that commit changed src/deliver.js (the retry loop) and did not touch src/backoff.js, and the verification report marks run 1 superseded for every AC. This is a material, unresolved Synchronizer-owned reconciliation error.

Apart from that error (and the open implementation-review finding F-002 that the faulty reconciliation was meant to answer), the implementation satisfies AC-001 to AC-004, and the verification report's run 2 is current, complete formal evidence; all 9 tests pass at HEAD.
No normal Documenter, final-review, or synchronization phase has started; the only downstream record is the IN_PROGRESS synchronization record produced by the earlier corrective return.

The correct outcome keeps CompletionPolicy IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED, records closure INELIGIBLE with the Synchronizer correction as the unmet requirement, and routes a SYNCHRONIZATION failure to SYNCHRONIZING with a frame that resumes REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION.

notes: Brownfield STANDARD cycle with CompletionPolicy IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED (user choice and reason saved in Active Work.Request). 00-project: pre-existing single-attempt webhook helper. 50: context, scope (AC-001..AC-004), design; STATE DEVELOPING. 51 (commit A): backoff helper, defaults, retry loop that also waits after the final attempt; plan COMPLETE; STATE TESTING. 52: Tester tests and verification report run 1 at A; STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. 53: implementation review IN_PROGRESS with F-001 (wait after last attempt, Developer); STATE DEVELOPING with frame 1. 54 (commit B): DEV-003 guard in src/deliver.js; STATE TESTING rerun. 55: test assertions strengthened, verification REVERIFY COMPLETE with run 2 at B and run 1 marked superseded; STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION via RESUME. 56: review updated (F-001 RESOLVED; F-002 OPEN, owner Synchronizer: evidence applicability unreconciled; closure section NOT_ASSESSED); STATE SYNCHRONIZING with a SYNCHRONIZATION frame. 57: Synchronizer corrective record IN_PROGRESS whose D-001 resolution falsely claims commit B changed only src/backoff.js and cites superseded run 1 as current for AC-001/003/004; frame popped, STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION via RESUME from SYNCHRONIZING, recovery inactive. No documentation or final-deliverable records exist. Compromise: the earlier Reviewer's choice to route evidence reconciliation to Synchronizer (rather than reconcile itself) is a slightly over-cautious but legal prior decision; it is the only way to give the cycle a current-cycle synchronization record from corrective work with normal downstream phases never started.
